description:
Sharepoint Developer  
 

 On behalf of our Client, Procom Services is searching for a Sharepoint Developer for a contract opportunity in Burlington, NC. 
 

 Sharepoint Developer Job Details  
 

 Architect, design and develop SharePoint Apps for SP version 2013. Responsible for training team members. Candidate should be well equipped to handle the complex situations posed by the environment e.g. Reverse Proxy/Kerberos Authentication.
 

 Sharepoint Developer Mandatory Skills  
 

 Experience C# and MVC-5 for apps development.
 Knowledge/experience on using Entity Framework with Oracle.
 Experience using UI Designing.
 

 Sharepoint Developer Start Date 
 ASAP
 

 Sharepoint Developer Assignment Length 
 

 3 Months
 

 "Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties." 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
